name: Mercury
description: The smallest planet and the closest to the Sun.
funFact: It has almost no atmosphere to keep its heat.

name: Venus
description: A rocky planet covered by thick, toxic clouds.
funFact: It is the hottest planet in the solar system.

name: Earth
description: Our home, with liquid water on its surface.
funFact: It is the only planet known to have life.

name: Mars
description: A cold, dusty planet known as the red planet.
funFact: It has Olympus Mons, the largest known volcano in the solar system.

name: Jupiter
description: The largest planet in the solar system.
funFact: Its Great Red Spot is a giant storm.

name: Saturn
description: A gas giant famous for its bright rings.
funFact: Its rings are mostly made of ice and rock.

name: Uranus
description: An ice giant with a pale blue color.
funFact: It rotates tilted on its side.

name: Neptune
description: The farthest planet from the Sun.
funFact: It has the fastest winds in the solar system.
